evidence.claim: Marazzi produce piastrelle in ceramica dal 1935 a Sassuolo ed è presente in più di 140 paesi, dai progettisti ai rivenditori.
evidence.quote: Marazzi was founded in 1935 at Sassuolo , in what was to become the top international hub for the creation of state-of-the-art, high-end ceramic tiles || Present in more than 140 countries , it is universally recognised as synonymous with quality ceramic tiles || both with designers, architects and contractors and with dealers and final customers
